tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Global gradient Hölder estimate] 1. ch8:8.33\group ch08-generalized-solutions If $\Omega $ is $C^{1,\alpha }$, $u\in C^{1,\alpha }(\overline\Omega )$ solves $Lu=g+D_if^i$, and $u=\varphi $ on $\partial \Omega $ for $\varphi \in C^{1,\alpha }(\overline\Omega )$, then \begin{equation} |u|_{1,\alpha } \leq C(|u|_0+|\varphi |_{1,\alpha }+|g|_0+|f|_{0,\alpha }), \tag {8.87} \end{equation} where $C=C(n,\lambda ,K,\partial \Omega )$.
Proof

\sketch Flatten the boundary by $C^{1,\alpha }$ charts, apply the corresponding constant-coefficient boundary estimate to (8.84), absorb the coefficient oscillation locally, and combine a finite boundary cover with Theorem 8.32.

□
